correctness.rationale: For fixed b, the scaled point cloud is Bin(n,b/n) with iid uniform conditional marks, while the limiting cloud is Pois(b) with the identical mark kernel. Le Cam coupling gives bounded-window marked-path TV <= b^2/n, and order-statistic identities give all clique birth clocks. In the limiting process adjacent clique waiting times share exactly one exponential, yielding Gamma(2,1) margins and covariance 1, while disjoint increments are independent. Direct finite integration gives the first-edge distribution and edge moments; Poisson minimum conditioning gives the complete component-size distribution. Exact-rational CHECKER.py completed 7,387 finite assertions. The infinite claims have analytic proofs independent of this checker. The strict inequality is handled with infimum birth times.

value.rationale: This is a motivated boundary transition between an empty graph and a growing extreme-weight core: the moving critical scale is sharp for every fixed clique. A complete graph-path law plus exact one-dependent Gamma gaps identifies a nonrenewal mechanism, and the component-size distribution shows which rare vertices actually form the only active component. Edge variance exceeds edge mean by t^3/3; independent-edge Poisson heuristics miss this persistent clustering. The finite exact survival formula and explicit total-variation bound make the result directly usable for numerical and probabilistic analysis.
